title: 第15章 装逼失败第16章 张婶也要玩真的
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大柱家里，他正好酒好菜的招待逼哥他们几个人。
“大柱，你说你也老大不小了，家里一个女人都没有，这酒喝的多没劲。”
逼哥说道，喝着好酒，吃着好菜，现在又有了更高的要求。
“李大柱，平常不是说你在牛犊子村多么多么厉害吗？给我们喊几个妞过来。”
“要带劲的那种，不带劲的不要。”
“赶紧的，别磨磨蹭蹭的。”
其他几个人开口催促，他们现在都有些喝多了，不仅说胡话，甚至都产生了幻觉。
“我上哪给你们找女人去。”
李大柱一脸为难，虽然平常在外面吹的自己很厉害，那都只是吹牛装逼的，听听就好了。
不过只见他眼神一亮，似乎还真想出了一个什么主意。
只见他回了自己房间，然后从箱子里拿出一个打气筒，接着对着一个干瘪的人形气球疯狂打气。
这是她在网上买的，花了好几百，而且还是明星同款。
老光棍的日子有些不太好过，这是他特意买来打发时间的，看着同款明星的面容，刚开始还挺兴奋。
“好了没有？”
“女人呢？”
“我要女人。”
逼哥在外面发飙，他可不是喝多了会睡觉的主儿，而是喝多了会发疯的主儿。
“来了来了，美女来了。”
李大柱连忙回道，气打的差不多了，他连忙将这同款明星的气球娃娃搬了出来。
逼哥几个人瞬间来了精神，似乎真的喝多了，一个个搓了搓眼睛，把这个娃娃当成了真正的美女。

“这不是，这不是……”
“她是谁来着？”
“逼哥，这是明星。”
李大柱说道，随后把这个打气的娃娃送到他的怀里。
“明星，不错不错，老子混了这么多年，还从来没有见过明星。”
逼哥兴奋万分，在酒精的刺激下，自然是有些胡作非为。
“妈的，让他们来帮我教训大炮那个傻子的，一个个来享受上了。”
李大柱非常无语，只希望把他们伺候好了，到时候能够帮他去教训李大炮。
李大炮现在正在玩木头人游戏，陪他一起玩的有叶秋玲，还有守在门外的叶长贵。
“大炮，游戏结束了，你赢了，我这就去给你拿馒头。”
叶秋玲说道，她心中非常难为情，这样欺负一个傻子，实在是太过意不去了。
李大炮立即摘下了眼罩，他有些意犹未尽，这才玩了半个小时不到，也太快了。
“大炮，拿着馒头赶快回去吧，要是有人问你，你就说在这帮我一起修房子。”
李长贵说道，他现在有些牛逼哄哄，只感觉装了逼之后，整个人的气度都不一样了。
这下全村的人，估计都知道他叶长贵的厉害，不知道有多少村妇晚上睡不着觉，会念叨着他的名字。
“哦，我知道了。”
李大炮答应一声，看了一眼俊俏叶秋玲，回去再想办法，看看怎么把她救出火坑。
“怎么样？事情办成了吧？”
李长贵立即问道，他有些迫不及待，似乎想马上就能抱娃。
“哪有这么容易，你以为种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆，想要孩子，那得看缘分的。”

叶秋玲说道，这可不是她胡说八道，也许一两次就能怀上，也许十次，二十次都不一定能怀上。
“这还得看缘分？”
content_en:
At Li Dazhu's house, he happened to entertain Brother Bi and the others with good food and wine.
"Dazhu, you said you are too old to be young. There is not a woman in the family. This wine is so boring."
Brother Bi said, after drinking good wine and eating good food, now he has higher requirements.
"Li Dazhu, don't you usually say how awesome you are in Niuduzi Village? Call us some girls."
"You want the exciting ones, not the boring ones."
"Hurry up, don't wait any longer."
Several other people urged him. They were all drunk now. Not only were they talking nonsense, they were even hallucinating.
"Where can I find a woman for you?"
Li Dazhu looked embarrassed. Although he usually boasted that he was very powerful outside, he was just bragging and pretending to be cool. Just listen to it.
But his eyes lit up, and he seemed to have come up with an idea.
I saw him return to his room, then take out a pump from the box, and then inflate crazily at a shriveled human-shaped balloon.
She bought this online, costing several hundred, and it was the same style as that of celebrities.
The old bachelor was having a hard time, so he bought this specially to pass the time. Looking at the faces of the same celebrities, he was quite excited at first.
"Are you ready?"
"Where's the woman?"
"I want a woman."
Brother forced to go crazy outside, he is not a boss who will sleep after drinking too much, but a boss who will go crazy after drinking too much.
"Come on, come on, the beauty is here."
Li Dazhu quickly replied, almost furious, and he quickly moved out the balloon doll of the same star.
Brother Bi and the other two people suddenly became energetic and seemed to have really drunk too much. They rubbed their eyes one by one and regarded this doll as a real beauty.
"This is not, this is not..."
"Who is she?"
"Brother, this is a star."
Li Dazhu said, and then put the cheering doll into his arms.
"Stars, not bad, not bad. I have been around for so many years, but I have never seen a star before."
Brother Bi was extremely excited, and under the stimulation of alcohol, he naturally acted a little wildly.
"Damn it, let them help me teach that idiot Cannon a lesson, let's enjoy it one by one."
Li Dazhu was very speechless, he just hoped to serve them well and then be able to help him teach Li Dapao a lesson.
Li Dapao is currently playing the wooden man game. He is accompanied by Ye Qiuling and Ye Changgui who is guarding the door.
"Cannon, the game is over, you win, I'm going to get you steamed buns right now."
Ye Qiuling said, she felt very embarrassed. It was too embarrassing to bully a fool like this.
Li Dapao immediately took off his blindfold. He was still a little unfinished. He had only been playing for less than half an hour, which was too fast.
"Dapao, take the steamed buns and go back quickly. If anyone asks you, just say you are here to help me repair the house."
Li Changgui said that he was a bit awesome now, but he felt that after pretending to be awesome, his whole demeanor was different.
Now everyone in the village probably knows how powerful Ye Changgui is. I don’t know how many village women can’t sleep at night, mumbling his name.
"Oh, I see."
Li Dapao agreed, glanced at the handsome Ye Qiuling, and went back to think of a way to save her from the fire pit.
"How's it going? Is the matter done?"
Li Changgui asked immediately. He couldn't wait, as if he wanted to hold the baby right away.
"It's not that easy. You think you'll reap melons if you sow melons, and reap beans if you sow beans. If you want to have children, it all depends on fate."
Ye Qiuling said that this was not nonsense. She might be able to get pregnant once or twice, but she might not be able to get pregnant ten or twenty times.
"Does it still depend on fate?"
